notes.title: Update: 0.1.0.2 (Closed Alpha)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31858276/34496f61a330081ba3a60c53403d20a586dc1223.gif

 Update List


 Implemented pause menu for when pressing start, or Esc in game
 Simplified input control window for keyboard and joystick
 Fixed players not able to customizing inputs in controls window

 Wining matches now brings up the pause menu rather than restarting to the main menu, for now
 Added attention image to splash screen
 Now allows all controller to control the main menu, and pause menu
